# HTTP API

Every endpoint and data model of the PackPlate API, read from the API's own OpenAPI description. A running API also serves this interactively at `/docs`.

- [`GET /locations`](#get-locations)
- [`GET /locations/{location_id}`](#get-locationslocation_id)

### `GET /locations`

Every location, with today's hours, whether it is open at `at`, and its crowd level.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [LocationSummary](#locationsummary) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /locations/{location_id}`

One location: open status, hours for the next 7 days, and the menus listed from today on.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [LocationDetail](#locationdetail) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /locations/{location_id}/menus`

Every menu at a location on `date` (default today), with all items at once.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `date` | query | string (date) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [Menu](#menu) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /freshness`

When ingestion last finished, and whether the data is stale at `at` (default now).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | [Freshness](#freshness) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /filters/locations/{location_id}/menus`

Every menu at a location on `date` (default today), each item checked against every profile.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `date` | query | string (date) or null | no |  |

**Request body:** [FilterRequest](#filterrequest)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [FilteredMenu](#filteredmenu) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /filters/group`

Every location, ranked for a group: where everyone has something that fits on `at`'s day.

Order: locations where everyone fits first, then those open at `at`, then by name.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | query | string (date-time) or null | no |  |

**Request body:** [FilterRequest](#filterrequest)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response | list of [GroupLocation](#grouplocation) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `POST /crowd/{location_id}`

Report how busy a location is right now. Returns the location's crowd level after it.

One report per location per client every CROWD_REPORT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS (429 otherwise).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Request body:** [CrowdReportIn](#crowdreportin)

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 201 Successful Response | [Crowd](#crowd) |
| 422 Validation Error | [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /health`

Whether the API is up, can reach the database, and has the expected schema.

schema is "current", "outdated" (run the Alembic migrations), or null
when the database is unreachable.

| Response | Body |
|---|---|
| 200 Successful Response |  |
